# MockKit

> Stateful mock servers in Swift for UI-test automation. MockQL serves GraphQL (a real SDL
> schema or a Swift result-builder declaration, validated YAML/JSON seeds, mutations as Swift
> closures over transactional state, graphql-transport-ws subscriptions). MockREST serves REST
> from an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 spec and/or a Swift endpoint DSL (auto-CRUD with
> filtering/sorting/pagination, validated requests, fault injection, auth simulation, CORS).
> Both fill unseeded fields with deterministic generated data and can share one localhost port
> and one state store through the MockCore platform.

Swift 6.3+, one SPM package (`https://github.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift.git`, from 0.1.0)
with six library products: `MockQL` / `MockQLCore` (GraphQL server / portable engine),
`MockREST` / `MockRESTCore` (REST server / portable engine), and `MockCore` /
`MockCoreTransport` (the platform, for writing a new protocol extension). The `…Core` engines
are NIO-free. Depend on the products you use; all share one version. Test-time tool only.

## Integration

- [MockQL agent integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/mockql/agents/integration-guide.md): self-contained instructions, canonical patterns, pitfalls, and an error→fix table
- [MockREST agent integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/mockrest/agents/integration-guide.md): the canonical XCUITest pattern, rules that prevent the common failures, and an error→fix table
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/README.md): overview, installation, composing GraphQL and REST on one port

## Reference

- [MockQL guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/MockQL.md): schemas, seeding, mutations, subscriptions, requirements
- [MockREST guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/MockREST.md): quick start, seeding, scope notes, known limitations
- [MockCore guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/MockCore.md): the modules and writing your own protocol extension
- [MockQL seed format specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/mockql/design/seed-format.md): the version/data/roots document format and validation rules
- [REST format specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/mockrest/design/rest-format.md): spec ingestion, state model, seed format, CRUD semantics, settled decisions
- [Platform architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/docs/architecture.md): module topology and the MockService seam
- [API documentation](https://swiftpackageindex.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/documentation): DocC for every module

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents working in this repository
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AlexNachbaur/mockkit-swift/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): style rules, where code belongs, and PR process
